test_title: PYST 33: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) KN – PX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be44853782e9640d0d955e1583ac49589b746f8c24fb9c21254914da398ae644.png] 

Option 2) HK – NU

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b67429d75618533197b66069e72bfc98c90fa0d852f57484cff4739b109b8776.png] 

Option 3) AD – FN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cd4950cc79ce1f0cf3c87ae49c95118f55357a2c73bd955bc49986dbdaacc4a.png] 

Option 4) XA – CK

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7064dd8b616817251963cdcc7a77e407afcc3114fab2afb265d2bf48096806e.png] 

Thus, out of all 'HK – NU' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
